description: §7.3.1 / §48.3.3 — a nested `fn` (the pure form) closes over the outer `let pos` and may read it, but `pos = pos + 1` mutates a binding declared outside the `fn`: E-FN-003.
rationale: §7.3.1: 'Inner `fn` declarations are subject to the same purity constraints as top-level `fn` (§48) — they may read outer bindings but may not mutate them (E-FN-003).' §48.3.3: 'A `fn` body SHALL NOT write to any variable declared outside the `fn`'s own scope boundary.'
